supported_claims: The BECCSV research protocol preregisters primary critical-miss outcome, minimum 20% relative reduction, false-alarm increase limit of 5 percentage points, catastrophe guard, abstention policy, paired consultation comparison and confidence interval plan.
ASR paired bootstrap resamples distinct consultation foregrounds with both arms intact and includes failed pairs.
Current uncertainty summaries explicitly report descriptive intervals only and leave probability/calibration unset.
limitations: A qualified clinical/statistical reviewer must approve severity mapping and false-alarm tolerance before acceptance evaluation.
Current development cohorts are small and do not establish clinical performance; no calibration reliability curve is valid without genuine labeled probabilities.
